description: Stamp a text or image watermark on PDF pages: centred or tiled across the page, with opacity, angle, size, colour and a page range. It reads upright on rotated pages. Text the standard PDF fonts cannot draw (Arabic, CJK…) is stamped as an image. Defaults match the website: "CONFIDENTIAL", Helvetica Bold 72 pt, #d64545, 25% opacity, 45°. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-watermark/

angle.description: Rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise as shown. Default 45.

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

gap.description: Space between tiles in points (tile mode). Default 80.

image.description: Image watermark instead of text: a local path or base64 (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG…).

mode.description: "center": one stamp in the middle; "tile": repeated across the page.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

pages.description: Pages to stamp: 1-based list like "1-3, 5, 8-" ("5-" = to the end, "-3" = first three, "3-1" = reversed). Also "all", "odd", "even", "last". Empty = all pages.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

scale.description: Image width as % of the page width. Default 40.

text.description: Watermark text (default "CONFIDENTIAL"). Ignored when "image" is given.

name: pdf_watermark
title: Watermark PDF
